scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
other_conditions: Eligible entities are State Livestock Agencies, Animal Husbandry Department, and State Government.
benefits_summary: One-time central grant of up to ₹1.5 crore for establishing a pig semen collection and processing laboratory, plus ₹30 lakh for consumables.
